messages:
Emily Chen: Opening a PR to clarify split-DNS + resolver fallback behavior for Private (light footprint) installs at edge colos. Need a minimal CoreDNS example, a short migration note for 1.3 -> 1.4, and two test commands. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 :eyes:

docs-bot: PR created: redwood-inference/docs #1234 - `split-dns: resolver fallback & migration` (CI queued)

Raj Patel: Can we show conditional forwarding for the KMS/HSM domain and an upstream DoT provider? Tiny CoreDNS config will help customers reproduce. Call out ordering: local stub -> internal forwarders -> DoT upstream.

Max Torres: Add quick test commands too. I usually suggest:
```
# verify coreDNS is answering
dig +short @127.0.0.1 -p 1053 kms.internal A
# check TLS endpoint using curl with host override
curl -v --resolve "api.private:443:10.0.0.10" https://api.private/health
```
Also note: if systemd-resolved is present, mention using the stub resolver port or nftables/iptables redirect for 53.

Olivia Nguyen: Also include a migration snippet for folks on <=1.3 who used /etc/hosts hacks: steps to remove host entries, enable the local stub listener, then apply the CoreDNS forward config. Link to infra migration script would be good.

Raj Patel: Wording nit: prefer `Private (light footprint)` in user docs rather than `Private-Lite`. Add a bullet about NXDOMAIN handling for kms.internal (set denial cache lower).

Emily Chen: Dropping the example CoreDNS block here so its easy to copy into the docs. Please suggest tweaks. If infra can spin this up in staging, ping me.

Emily Chen: ```
.:1053 {
    forward . 1.1.1.1 1.0.0.1 tls_servername=cloud-dns.example.com
    forward kms.internal 10.0.0.20 10.0.0.21
    cache {
        success 3600
        denial 60
    }
    log
}
```

Max Torres: For the DoT upstream we may need the `tls` plugin stanza depending on CoreDNS version  add note about CoreDNS >=1.10 for `tls_servername`.

Olivia Nguyen: I'll test this afternoon in the staging edge cluster and post results here. Testing hostfile->stub migration and fresh install.

docs-bot: CI passed for #1234  spelling checks and link validation OK.

Max Torres: UX suggestion: add a one-line troubleshooting checklist in the doc header: `1) verify local resolver, 2) verify internal forwarders, 3) test DoT upstream, 4) remove host overrides`  keeps support tickets shorter.

Emily Chen: Merged after Olivia confirmed staging tests. I'll follow up with a short release note and link to the installer flag `--use-stub-resolver`.
